B) Confirm s-<hash8> for NEW epics only and leave channel-adoption and griot-mcp-comm-layer as tolerated dialects, documented
C) Amend the stories contract to bless STORY-NNN and re-emit the three s-hash epics - note this breaks the stability property the ids exist for
D) Rule on the third convention (GMCL-CN) separately
